title: Coupling identity via noise operators
statement: Let $\rho,a,b\in\mathbb R$ with $\rho\in[-1,1]$ and $ab=\rho$, and let $f,g:\{-1,1\}\to\mathbb R$. Choose $(X,Y)$ by taking $X$ uniform on $\{-1,1\}$ and, given $X$, setting $Y=X$ with probability $(1+\rho)/2$ and $Y=-X$ otherwise. Then $\mathbb E[f(X)g(Y)]=\langle T_a f,T_b g\rangle$, where $T_c h(x)=h_{\mathrm e}+c h_{\mathrm o}x$, $h_{\mathrm e}=(h(1)+h(-1))/2$, $h_{\mathrm o}=(h(1)-h(-1))/2$, and the inner product is the uniform average over $\{-1,1\}$.
